text: I'm glad you're enjoying your keyboard practice! Given your time constraint, you might consider focusing on the section where you tend to lose your place. Try working through it at a pace that allows you to follow the notes. Once you feel more comfortable, you can attempt to connect it to the section that comes before it. Keep in mind that you don't need to cover the entire piece in this session, and it's unlikely you'll see significant improvement within the next ten minutes.
